info.title: CECT / YEM API
info.description: API de la plateforme CECT / YEM : adhésions, packs, quotas, opérations YEM, validations et contre-valeurs FCFA. Toutes les erreurs ont la forme { code, message, details, correlation_id } ; les mutations financières exigent l'en-tête Idempotency-Key.

post.description:
Returns the pack and, unless it is free, the hosted checkout to pay (201). A subscription already awaiting
payment returns its checkout as is (200). The pack is activated only when the provider confirms the payment.
post.summary: Subscribe to a published pack

get.summary: Top-ups of one of the member's Personnel packs, most recent first

post.summary:
Top up a Personnel pack ("rechargement Perso"): the member chooses the amount (at least the pack's minimum)
and the method. The YEM bought are credited once the payment is confirmed by the provider or validated by the
CECT. Returns the top-up and the payment to complete (201), or the one already awaiting payment (200)

get.summary: Quota movements of the member's packs, most recent first

get.description:
`fee_due` is what the cooperative must receive. `payment_quote` adds the provider's transaction fees,
borne by the member, to give the total charged. Everything is computed by the server; the membership row
only exists once a payment has been started.
get.summary: Membership status, the fee due and the amount to pay

post.description:
Choose a method (T-Money, Flooz, cash, bank transfer). For a provider method the response carries the hosted
checkout link; for a manual one (cash, declared deposit), the instructions to pay, then the payment is declared
and validated by the CECT. An attempt already awaiting payment with the same method is returned as is (200).
The account becomes ACTIVE only when the provider confirms the payment server-side.
post.summary: Start a payment of the membership fee

get.summary: Status of one of your payment attempts

post.summary: Ask the platform to re-check an attempt with the provider (useful when the confirmation is late)
Declare a payment made outside the provider (cash handed over, Mobile Money deposit, transfer), with its reference
DEMO_GATEWAY_BYPASS: activate the account without payment. Not available in production
Issue a QR code for an active Pack Marchand, optionally for a point of sale
Replace a QR code by a new one (leak, change of Business Pernum): the old one stops working immediately

post.summary:
Ask the CECT to redeem collected YEM: reserves the quantity on the eligible balance (and on the Pack Marchand's
periodic quota when configured) and returns the CECT Pernum to send the YEM to. The request then follows the
member exchange endpoints (declare-sent, cancel) and the Validator's confirmation makes the counter-value payable

post.description:
Public endpoint: the request is authenticated by the provider's signature over the raw body. Duplicates
are acknowledged without being processed twice, and the outcome is always re-read from the provider.

post.description:
The account is created in PENDING_EMAIL_VERIFICATION and a verification code is sent by email.
The response gives the membership fee computed by the server and, when the payment provider is configured,
the amount to pay with transaction fees.
